name: WCCM Malaysia
reason: Too thin: wccmmalaysia.org's only current items are a list of local meditation groups; its 'Online Meditation' post (2021) has no content, the meditation-with-children posts date from 2018 and the introductory workshop (3 Aug 2026) has passed.
